# tfh-local egress allow-list (tinyproxy, POSIX ERE on host name). DEFAULT DENY: anything not listed is blocked.
#
# These entries take effect ONLY with EXTERNALS=real: scripts/preflight.sh writes the effective proxy filter to the
# gitignored .state/egress/allowlist.txt (EMPTY when EXTERNALS=offline; these entries plus the single derived Sticky
# API host <STICKY_APP_KEY>.<STICKY_DOMAIN> when EXTERNALS=real). The proxy reads only that generated file.
#
# ONLY the reviewed NON-PROD Sticky / TF Composition API hosts may be listed here (each must be on
# safety/nonprod-hosts.txt and either miss safety/prod-denylist.txt or be an exact safety/reviewed-exceptions.txt entry).
# NEVER add Klaviyo (use the recorder), AWS/S3 (use MinIO), Syteline/Infor, tfhcore, Avalara, Sentry, CloudWatch,
# the prod TF API host or any other production host. Approved by Michael 2026-11-20.
^limelightcrm\.com$
^api\.dev\.trulyfree\.com$
# Spreedly core API (Michael 2026-11-20 7:02 PM ET: add the Spreedly key develop/stage use). Same host for sandbox and
# prod; tfh-local only ever sets the SANDBOX environment key (NEXT_PUBLIC_SPREEDLY_ENVIRONMENT_KEY_TF). No access secret.
^core\.spreedly\.com$
